motions.motion: APPROVE the Royal Holladay Hills, “Block B,” Concept Plan at 1915 East Rodeo Walk Drive based on the following findings: 1. The approval is based on the plan that was presented at the Planning Commission Meeting regarding the old Macy’s building, the parking, and the landscape plan around the Macy’s building, including the triangle to the south. 2. The concept subdivision requirements are sufficiently and substantially met and comply with the requirements for submission, the SDMP, and the R-M/U Zone
motions.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission.
The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission.
